RuleDescription: HTTP or HTTPS URL without query parameters
EUI-64 or extended MAC-like hardware identifier
Example: Ido chip status changed: FF:F2:9F:16:E2:23:00:0D:60:E9:1D:DC ip=10.0.0.151 v=9 t=4 status=M Fri Jul 01 08:16:53 PDT 2005
Template: Ido chip status changed: <*> ip=<*> v=<*> t=<*> status=M <*>

Example: hostControllerOnline - Number of Paired devices = 1, List of Paired devices = ( "84-41-67-32-db-e1" )
Template: hostControllerOnline - Number of Paired devices = <*>, List of Paired devices = ( "<*>-<*>-<*>-<*>-<*>-<*>" )

RuleDescription: Human-readable date-time with weekday and month name
Example: User unknown timed out after 900 seconds at Sat Jun 18 02:23:10 2005
Template: User unknown timed out after <*> seconds at <*>

RuleDescription: Time only in HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.sss format
Example: [09:21:58.929] <<<< CRABS >>>> crabsFlumeHostAvailable: [ConsumerUI] Byte flume reports host available again.
Template: [<*>] <<<< CRABS >>>> crabsFlumeHostAvailable: [<*>] Byte flume reports host available again.

RuleDescription: IPv4 address followed by a port number
Domain or hostname followed by a port number
Example: www.baidu.com:80 open through proxy proxy.cse.cuhk.edu.hk:5070 HTTPS
NFS Mount failed on bglio716, slept 15 seconds, retrying (1)
Template: NFS Mount failed on <*>, slept <*> seconds, retrying (<*>)

RuleDescription: Software or semantic version number with two or more dots
Decimal number not inside an IP address
Example: Node card status: ALERT 0, ALERT 1, ALERT 2, ALERT 3 is (are) active. The 2.5 volt rail is OK. The 1.5 volt rail is OK.
Template: Node card status: ALERT <*> The <*> volt rail is OK. The <*> volt rail is OK.
